label: Liquidity pool above (buyside) reclaimed (3, 0.1 ATR)
gloss: whether this bar's close is back at or below the buyside liquidity pool the previous bar's close retired — true is a two-bar sweep of that pool, a close above it and then a close back; absent when the previous bar retired no buyside pool — a buyside pool forms on the bar that confirms an equal high — a recorded pivot high of length 3 within 0.1 × ATR(200) of the previous recorded one, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0's EQH rule — at the newer pivot's price, and stays intact until a close above it retires it (LuxAlgo Liquidity Swings); several pools are kept at once — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent when no pool is intact, and absent where a pool formed before the bars read prove the equal pivots could be nearer, so it can read absent while price trades beyond every close the bars read since then

equalBars.description: The equal highs and lows’ pivot length, each side (LuxAlgo’s Bars Confirmation).

equalThreshold.description: How close two pivots must be to be equal, as a fraction of ATR(200) at the deciding bar.
